meta.name: alfworld-task-verifier
meta.description: Use when the agent needs to check whether an ALFWorld task objective has been met after completing a sub-action (e.g., placing an object). This skill parses the task goal, evaluates the latest environment observation, and outputs a verification decision — task complete, task incomplete, or action ineffective — to guide the next step.

copy.tagline: 验证 ALFWorld 任务目标是否达成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 ALFWorld 环境中自动检查任务完成状态。
copy.tagline_en: Verify if ALFWorld task objective is met
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically check task completion in ALFWorld environment.

howto.what: Claude在完成放置物体等子动作后，会自动检查任务是否达成，并输出“任务完成”“任务未完成”或“动作无效”的结论，指导下一步。
howto.when: 当Claude在ALFWorld游戏中执行了放置或操作物体的动作后，需要验证任务进度时触发。

say.text: 检查当前任务完成了没有？
say.note: Claude会解析任务目标并评估最新观察结果。

say.text: 我刚放完物体，验证一下。
say.note: 触发验证，输出任务状态。
检查上次动作是否成功。

howto.what_en: After completing a sub-action like placing an object, Claude automatically checks whether the ALFWorld task goal is met, outputting 'task complete', 'task incomplete', or 'action ineffective' to guide the next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude has just performed a key sub-action (e.g., put object in/on receptacle) in ALFWorld and needs to verify task progress.

say_en.text: Check if the current task is complete.
say_en.note: Claude parses the goal and evaluates the observation.

say_en.text: I just placed an object, verify it.

say_en.note: Checks if the last action succeeded.
